source_artifacts.texcup_rtk_demo5.conf:
# RTKLIB demo5 v2.5.1 rnx2rtkp config - TEX-CUP 2019-05-09 kinematic RTK
# Protocol signal set: GPS C1C+C2W, GAL C1C+C7Q (E1+E5b), BDS C2I (B1I single-freq).
# Enforced primarily by pre-stripped RINEX inputs (loaders/rinex_strip.py removes
# GPS 2L and GAL 5Q sets); pos1-frequency=l1+l2 limits to freq indices 0,1
# (demo5 maps: GPS L1/L2, GAL E1/E5b, BDS B1I only in this data).
# NOTE: pos1-l2cprior does not exist in demo5 v2.5.1 (removed); the built-in code
# priority "CPYWMNDLSX" for GPS L2 already prefers 2W over 2L, and 2L is stripped.
#
# Deviations from demo5 built-in defaults (prcopt_default/solopt_default):
#   pos1-frequency  l1+l2 (= default nf=2, set explicitly per protocol)
#   pos1-navsys     41 = GPS(1)+Galileo(8)+BeiDou(32); default 45 includes GLONASS
#   ant2-postype    rinexhead (base APPROX POSITION XYZ -742080.4125 -5462031.7412 3198339.6909)
#   out-solformat   xyz (ECEF, for direct antenna comparison)
#   out-outstat     residual (writes .pos.stat used to VERIFY signals/freqs used)
# Everything else demo5 v2.5.1 defaults: kinematic, AR fix-and-hold (arthres 3.0,
# arfilter on), dynamics on, elmask 15 deg, broadcast eph/iono/tropo.

pos1-posmode       =kinematic  # (demo5 default)
pos1-frequency     =l1+l2      # freq indices 0,1: GPS L1/L2, GAL E1/E5b, BDS B1I
pos1-navsys        =41         # (1:gps+8:gal+32:bds), GLONASS off
ant2-postype       =rinexhead  # base station position from RINEX header
out-solformat      =xyz        # (0:llh,1:xyz,2:enu,3:nmea)
out-timesys        =gpst       # solution time tags in GPST (loader converts to UTC)
out-outstat        =residual   # .pos.stat for per-signal verification
out-outheader      =on

path_convention: Paths within the benchmark are relative to the repository root. TEX-CUP input paths refer to data/tex_cup. Angle-bracket environment, home and temporary roots are symbolic references, not executable paths. Source run paths identify the original generated runs; those runtime directories need not be distributed with the saved results. Scientific configuration, coordinate/time rules and run status are retained.
